vulnerabilities.justification: O endpoint /score/get/{userId}/{stageId} permite acesso a dados de qualquer usuário com base em userId fornecido pelo cliente, sem verificação se o usuário autenticado corresponde ao recurso solicitado.
O endpoint /progress/get aceita o parâmetro nickname diretamente da requisição e permite consulta de progresso de outros usuários sem validação de autorização baseada no usuário autenticado.

vulnerabilities.vulnerability_type: Improper Exception Handling in Security Filter
vulnerabilities.justification: O filtro de autenticação lança RuntimeException quando o token está ausente, o que pode resultar em erro 500 em vez de resposta adequada de autenticação (401), causando comportamento inseguro e possível vazamento de informações.
User password is persisted and retrieved directly from the database without hashing or encryption.

vulnerabilities.vulnerability_type: Sensitive data exposure (password returned in queries)
vulnerabilities.justification: User password is loaded from the database and populated into entity objects, exposing sensitive credentials to application layers.
SQL exceptions are wrapped in RuntimeException and propagated, potentially exposing internal database details and stack traces.

vulnerabilities.vulnerability_type: Incorrect foreign key usage causing data association leakage
vulnerabilities.justification: Queries in ScoreDAOImpl use score id instead of user_id/stage_id when fetching related entities, which can lead to incorrect data retrieval and unintended information disclosure.
JWT HMAC secret key is hardcoded in source code, exposing signing key and allowing token forgery if code is compromised.

vulnerabilities.vulnerability_type: Plaintext Password Storage in Memory Model
vulnerabilities.justification: User entity stores password as plain String without hashing or encryption, increasing risk of credential exposure.
Exception message includes raw input value in IllegalArgumentException, which may leak internal validation details.

vulnerabilities.vulnerability_type: Null Pointer Dereference in Authentication User Loading
vulnerabilities.justification: loadUserByUsername returns new UserDetailsImpl(user) without checking if user is null, which can cause NullPointerException when an unknown username is provided.

vulnerabilities.vulnerability_type: Null Pointer Dereference on Score Retrieval
vulnerabilities.justification: scoreDAO.findByUserIdAndStageId may return null and is used without validation in addPointsToScore, leading to potential NullPointerException.

vulnerabilities.vulnerability_type: Use of Weak Pseudo-Random Number Generator
vulnerabilities.justification: java.util.Random is used for positioning sensitive game/state logic, which is not cryptographically secure and may allow prediction of generated positions.
